title: Version 3.11: Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Cursor v3.11 added side chats for parallel conversations, agent transcript search capabilities, and redesigned project/repository pickers. Also introduced new cloud agent hooks, MCP support in team marketplaces, and iOS mobile app with cloud agents and remote control.

title: Cursor Automations with /automate Skill and Computer Use
description: Cursor introduced /automate skill for creating automations in plain language, new GitHub and Slack triggers (including emoji reactions), and computer use tool for cloud agents to produce demos and artifacts.

title: Customize Page and Plugin Canvases
description: Cursor added a new Customize page consolidating plugins, skills, MCPs, subagents, rules, commands, and hooks management. Introduced plugin canvases with shared templates like Hex Canvas and Atlassian Canvas, plus marketplace leaderboard.

title: Monthly Recap and Focus Settings for Web and Desktop
description: Claude added monthly recap feature showing topics users spent time on, active days, peak hours, and work insights. Also added break reminders and quiet hours at Settings > Time and focus.

title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Models Now Available
description: GitHub Copilot added support for OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna models on July 9, 2026, bringing newer AI model capabilities to the platform.

title: GitHub Mobile: Copilot Cloud Agent and Live Notifications
description: GitHub Mobile added features to fix merge conflicts with Copilot cloud agent and live notifications for Copilot CLI sessions on July 8, 2026.

title: Claude Cowork Expands to Web and Mobile
description: Claude Cowork is now available on web and mobile (in addition to desktop), allowing sessions and files to sync across all devices. Beta rollout started with Max users, with background work continuing and scheduled tasks running with no device online.

title: Claude Code and Cowork Available for Government with FedRAMP High
description: Anthropic launched public beta of Claude Code and Claude Cowork in Claude for Government Desktop, built on FedRAMP High authorized environment. Includes desktop file-based work, admin controls, tamper-evident audit logs, and spend governance for agencies.

title: Enhanced Admin Controls for Enterprise
description: Claude Enterprise added richer admin analytics, model-level entitlements, and spend alerts. Admins can now track usage by group/user, set model defaults, and configure spend-threshold alerts to avoid overages.

title: Copilot Vision Generally Available
description: GitHub Copilot Vision became generally available on July 1, 2026, allowing Copilot to see and understand images within the development environment.

title: Browser Tools for VS Code Generally Available
description: Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code became generally available on July 1, 2026, enabling Copilot to interact with web content during development sessions.

title: Kimi K2.7 Code Generally Available
description: Kimi K2.7 Code model became generally available in GitHub Copilot on July 1, 2026, expanding the available AI model options for developers.
